verdict.rationale: Asaas's own docs list subscriptions among its API features (asaas-docs-2) and mention creating recurring Automatic Pix payments (asaas-docs-20), so recurring billing is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence describes plan objects, trial periods, upgrades/downgrades, or proration. Missing for 10: documented subscription API details, plan/pricing-tier management, trial periods, upgrade/downgrade flows, proration logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.
